svg.title: Mode delays and transfer function of the OM4 fiber
svg.desc: (a) Relative group delay of all 90 LP modes after 100 m versus their principal mode group, marker area proportional to the launched power: the excited modes lie within a few picoseconds; a few near-cutoff modes with much larger delay carry almost no power and are drawn off scale. (b) Magnitude of the fiber transfer function on optical power for 50, 100 and 150 m; the optical -3 dB bandwidth falls with length.
